TaskDescription: Switching between an external-attention visual search task (find the T among 35 Ls on a 6x6 grid, report upper/lower half) and an internal-attention autobiographical memory task (yes/no answer to a statement about own past experiences), gamepad responses, max 5 s per trial, no pause between trials; four sessions of several minutes (about 30 min in total). Epochs are centred on the switch between tasks (E-I: external-to-internal, I-E: internal-to-external).
ManufacturersModelName: Quantum amplifiers, NeuroWorks software (as named in Hammer et al. 2024)
iEEGReference: bipolar (each contact referenced to its nearest neighbour on the same shank); original recording reference in white matter
iEEGElectrodeGroups: DIXI Medical SEEG electrodes (0.8 mm diameter, 2 mm contacts, 1.5 mm spacing)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined SEEG implantation; only channels assigned by the authors to the DMN or DAN (Yeo-7) are released; channels in seizure-onset/irritative zones or broken were removed by the authors
